status.en: 73 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 20% more than the week before, most of them in Tehran, Qeshm and Gulf Of Oman.
status.nb: 73 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 20 prosent flere enn uken før, flest i Teheran, Qeshm og Omanbukta.

summary.en: Iran has expanded its attacks, striking a U.S. air base in Kuwait and sites in Bahrain with drones and missiles, while also claiming mines hit five ships in the Hormuz Strait. The United States responded with airstrikes on Iranian missile launch sites on Qeshm Island and on vessels in the Gulf of Oman, citing self-defence. A whistleblower alleges the deadly drone strike in Kuwait could have been avoided, adding a new dimension of internal criticism to the conflict. 123 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.
